selection_rules.app_icon: Use the explicit OS-theme + app-theme combination when platform permits dynamic selection; otherwise use the neutral default.
selection_rules.dark_app_on_light_os: Use white mark on charcoal/black tile; do not use a transparent black mark because it disappears on the light shell/window boundary.
selection_rules.light_app_on_dark_os: Use black mark on light tile with subtle border; do not use a transparent white mark for the packaged app icon.
